Name: Radisson Blu
Company description: Welcome to the official page for Radisson Blu, a brand of Radisson Hotel Group. Stylish living spaces for business and leisure in some of the world’s favorite destinations. Choose stylish and elegant hotels that are created with you in mind. Enjoy a warm welcome with our inviting ambience and thoughtful touches designed to please. Let our attentive team take care of the small details that make a big difference to your stay in the most desirable of destinations, which combine convenience and individuality. Radisson Blu is a part of the Radisson Hotel Group portfolio which also includes Radisson Collection, Radisson, Radisson RED, Radisson Individuals, Park Plaza, Park Inn by Radisson, Country Inn & Suites by Radisson, and prizeotel brought together under one commercial umbrella brand Radisson Hotels. Connect with Radisson Blu on social media: @RadissonBlu.

Name: Haymarket By Scandic
Company description: Art Deco hotel in the heart of Stockholm. Step into the roaring twenties and experience #ThatHaymarketFeeling

Name: Scandic Laholmen
Company description: Vi är ett modernt fullservicehotell med fokus på personlig service och tillmötesgående atmosfär. Sedan 1984 har vi levererat kvalitetsfyllda upplevelser inom hotell, konferens, restaurang och nöje.  Hotellets läge på en halvö i hamnen är unikt med närhet till både havet och Strömstad centrum.  Laholmen ingår i Scandic Hotels och är ett franschisehotell, och efterlever självklart kedjans krav för värdskap, miljöhänsyn, service och kvalitet.  Här hittar du moderna konferensfaciliteter, mat och dryck på en mycket hög nivå, underhållning med pianobar och nattklubb och vi anordnar flera roliga events per år. Vi skräddarsyr även för grupper efter önskemål.

Name: Scandic Hotels
Company description: Scandic is the largest Nordic hotel operator with a network of about 280 hotels with 57,000 rooms in six countries. Every day, over 10,000 team members work for you to enjoy your stay, whether you happen to be in Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Norway, Germany or Poland. Scandic was founded in 1963 and since then, we have been a pioneer, driving development within the hotel industry. We operate in the mid-market segment under our industry-leading brand, Scandic.

Name: Pandox
Company description: Pandox AB is a leading hotel property company based in Stockholm, Sweden, specializing in the ownership, management, and development of hotel properties across Europe. Established in 1995, Pandox has built a diverse portfolio of 163 hotel properties, encompassing approximately 36,000 rooms in 11 countries, with a total market value exceeding SEK 76 billion. The company's mission is to create value through long-term, revenue-based leases with skilled hotel operators, ensuring a collaborative approach that aligns the interests of both parties in enhancing profitability and property value. Pandox primarily targets the upper mid-market segment, catering to both leisure and business travelers, and has established strong partnerships with renowned hotel brands such as Hilton, Scandic, and Radisson Blu. Pandox is committed to sustainability, actively working to minimize its environmental impact through eco-friendly practices and responsible sourcing. The company emphasizes energy efficiency and aims to achieve significant reductions in greenhouse gas emissions, aligning its operations with international sustainability standards. By fostering a corporate culture that values diversity and inclusion, Pandox prioritizes employee satisfaction and development, with staff from over 80 countries contributing to its success. The company operates through two main business segments: Leases, which accounts for the majority of its portfolio, and Own Operations, where it directly manages hotels. Pandox's strategic focus on long-term, turnover-based leases allows for shared growth and downside protection in fluctuating markets, positioning it as a key player in the competitive hospitality sector. By continuously investing in property renovations and enhancements, Pandox seeks to elevate the hotel experience and ensure that its properties meet the evolving demands of guests. Through its commitment to responsible business practices and community engagement, Pandox aims to contribute positively to the local communities in which it operates while delivering strong financial performance for its stakeholders.

Name: Clarion Hotel Sign
Company description: Clarion Hotel Sign is a premier hotel situated in the heart of Stockholm, adjacent to Norra Bantorget square and conveniently near Stockholm Central Station. The hotel offers a harmonious blend of modern Scandinavian design and comfort, making it an ideal choice for both leisure and business travelers. With a mission to provide exceptional hospitality, Clarion Hotel Sign focuses on creating memorable experiences through quality accommodations and personalized service. The hotel features 558 well-appointed rooms equipped with amenities such as minibars, climate control, and complimentary Wi-Fi, ensuring a comfortable stay for all guests. The hotel caters to a diverse clientele, including families, tourists exploring the vibrant city, and corporate guests seeking convenient meeting facilities. Clarion Hotel Sign boasts spacious conference facilities that can accommodate up to 600 participants, making it a preferred venue for business events. The hotel also offers a range of amenities, including a rooftop garden, spa, and diverse dining options, such as a breakfast buffet featuring local and organic ingredients, as well as a bar for relaxation. In addition to its commitment to exceptional service, Clarion Hotel Sign places a strong emphasis on sustainability. The hotel is dedicated to reducing its environmental impact and aims to achieve climate neutrality by 2030. This commitment not only enhances the guest experience but also reflects the hotel's responsibility towards the environment. Strategic partnerships with local attractions and businesses further enrich the overall experience for guests, solidifying Clarion Hotel Sign's reputation as a top choice for those visiting Stockholm.

Name: Sembo Group
Company description: Sembo was founded 1987 in Helsingborg. The business idea was to offer affordable self drive packages to destinations around the Mediterranean on the Swedish market. Ever since then we have challenged the industry by selling dynamically packaged trips with different types of components. In fact in 2003, we were one of the first in the world to do this. Since 1987, we have accumulated a wealth of knowledge, experience and data that now means we dare to take the next step. Now we are developing a completely unique booking platform that will create great value for people to book completely unique user-generated trips in the future. A one stop shop for travel and experiences.  We have a bright view of the future. Where we built a data-driven travel tech company with big visions. Traveling is on most people's bucket list. At Sembo, we help people live their dreams. We became a part of Stena Line in 2007. A great opportunity to let Sembo create dynamic packages with ferry & hotel. This is something we still do today. Stena AB is one of the largest family-owned companies in Sweden and has global operations in shipping, ferry lines, offshore, real estate and finance. Stena also creates new businesses for the future.  Sembo is part of the Stena Line Travel & Retail Group. It's a business division within the Stena Line Group focused on leisure travel. The group has a turnover of more than 200 MEUR and operations within several European markets.

Name: Stureplansgruppen
Company description: Sweden’s largest entertainment group, Stureplansgruppen is active across the restaurant, entertainment, congress, contract catering, hotel and experience industries in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Visby and Åre. The company provides unique integrated solutions underpinned by a business idea which focuses on creating service-orientated meeting places and delivering premium quality entertainment experiences through a keen insight into the lifestyle and entertainment needs of its guests. At Stureplansgruppen, we endeavour to continuously lie at the cutting edge of the industry by creating and delivering unique value for our visitors, at the same time as offering a safe, secure experience. Our venues and events reflect the latest trends within cuisine, beverage, music and design. We create integrated concepts for individual guests as well as large groups, delivering overall solutions from start to finish. What makes Stureplansgruppen unique is its capacity to offer first class solutions from a single company spanning congresses, events, catering, conferencing, hotels,restaurants, nightclubs and concerts, while also handling marketing, sales and production within these areas through its own channels.

Name: Gothia Towers
Company description: Gothia Towers is a premier hotel located in Gothenburg, Sweden, offering a unique blend of comfort and convenience for both leisure and business travelers. The hotel is strategically situated near popular attractions such as Liseberg Amusement Park and the Swedish Exhibition & Congress Centre, making it an ideal choice for families and event attendees alike. Gothia Towers aims to provide exceptional hospitality experiences, with a mission to create memorable stays through quality service and a range of amenities, including family-friendly activities and a luxurious spa. The hotel caters to a diverse clientele, including families, business professionals, and tourists, and partners with local attractions to enhance guest experiences. With a commitment to sustainability and community engagement, Gothia Towers strives to be a welcoming haven for all visitors to Gothenburg.

Name: ESS Group
Company description: ESS Group is a dynamic company specializing in hotel, restaurant, and concept development, dedicated to creating unique experiences and meeting places that reflect distinct character. With a mission to meet and exceed guest expectations, ESS Group emphasizes the importance of personal commitment, professionalism, and passion in delivering world-class results. The company operates under a set of core values encapsulated in "the little red book," which guides their service promise and goal of fostering loyal guests. Their target market includes individuals seeking memorable experiences in hospitality, and they pride themselves on their ability to adapt to the evolving needs of their clientele. ESS Group's commitment to employee development ensures that both guests and staff enjoy "The Time of Your Life" during their interactions with the brand.

Name: Stockholmsmässan
Company description: Inspiration and information, business opportunities and new friends. Stockholmsmässan is the largest meeting place in Scandinavia hosting around 70 leading exhibitions and hundreds of national and international congresses, conferences and corporate events every year. Love to meet you!

Name: MIAB
Company description: MIAB specializes in providing professional hotel cleaning and housekeeping services across Sweden and Finland, ensuring that every hotel room is left sparkling clean and well-maintained. With a mission to enhance the guest experience and strengthen hotel reputations, MIAB collaborates with a diverse range of clients, from large hotel chains like Strawberry, Holiday Club, and Scandic to small boutique hotels. The company is committed to delivering tailored cleaning solutions that adapt to the specific needs of each hotel, focusing on guest comfort and operational efficiency. By utilizing environmentally friendly products and maintaining high standards of service, MIAB aims to contribute to customer satisfaction and a pleasant hotel environment. Each year, MIAB services over 1.6 million hotel rooms, showcasing its dedication to quality and reliability in the hospitality industry.

Name: MOMENT GROUP AB
Company description: Moment Group AB is a prominent operator in the experience industry, dedicated to crafting memorable moments for over 2 million guests annually across Scandinavia. The company specializes in a wide array of offerings, including shows, musicals, theaters, concerts, dining experiences, and event management, all aimed at fostering meaningful connections among people, brands, and communities. With a mission to enhance well-being through shared experiences, Moment Group strives to provide entertainment that delights while contributing to a sustainable society.  Operating under several well-known brands, including 2Entertain, Wallmans Group, and Kungsportsgruppen, Moment Group collaborates with various partners, such as Axfood and SEB, to deliver high-quality productions and events. The company maintains a strong presence in major cities like Gothenburg, Stockholm, and Copenhagen, with 15 venues that cater to a diverse clientele, including corporate partners and cultural institutions.  Moment Group's vision is to establish itself as a leader in the experience sector, which it believes is poised for long-term growth. The company emphasizes sustainability in its operations, aiming to reduce its environmental impact while fostering profitable growth. Despite facing challenges during the COVID-19 pandemic, Moment Group has demonstrated resilience and adaptability, focusing on enhancing its operational capabilities and financial stability.  With a commitment to quality and innovation, Moment Group AB is poised to capitalize on the growing demand for experiential entertainment, targeting sales of SEK 1.3 billion by 2028. The company employs over 400 staff and is publicly listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, reflecting its significant role in the regional economy and its dedication to community engagement. Through strategic initiatives and a focus on customer satisfaction, Moment Group aims to enhance its offerings and expand its market presence in the competitive experience industry.

Name: Lotus Hotel Group AB
Company description: Vi brinner för att skapa fantastiska upplevelser för våra gäster – på platser där vardagen alltid är avlägsen. Vi är en grupp av hotell och kollegor som tillsammans levererar hög kvalité med passion och yrkesstolthet. Vi verkar i lokalt starka, historiska och spännande miljöer. I vår familj ingår ett av Sveriges äldsta hotell och två av landets mest omtyckta spadestinationer. På våra hotell finner du unika rum för avkoppling, god mat och dryck, evenemang, konferens och spännande möten. I Lotus Hotel Group ingår Varbergs Stadshotell & Asia Spa, Arken Hotel & Art Garden Spa, Hôtel Eggers i Göteborg och Billingehus i Skövde.

Name: Jacy'z Hotel & Resort
Company description: Jacy'z Hotel & Resort is a premier destination in Gothenburg, offering a luxurious experience across 27 floors of entertainment, dining, and relaxation. The resort features a stunning turquoise pool, a variety of upscale restaurants including the Asian fusion skybar Gogogaga, and a lavish spa, all designed to provide guests with an unforgettable stay. Jacy'z aims to create a vibrant atmosphere where guests can indulge in comfort food, handcrafted cocktails, and breathtaking city views, making it a perfect choice for both leisure travelers and business events. The hotel's mission is to blend luxury with a relaxed ambiance, catering to a diverse clientele that includes couples, families, and corporate groups. With a focus on exceptional service and unique experiences, Jacy'z Hotel & Resort partners with local businesses to enhance its offerings and attract visitors seeking both adventure and relaxation in the heart of Gothenburg.

Name: Elite Hotels Of Sweden AB
Company description: Elite Hotels of Sweden AB is a prominent hotel chain that operates a collection of upscale hotels across Sweden, including the renowned Elite Plaza Hotel in Gothenburg. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional hospitality experiences, with a mission to ensure guest comfort and satisfaction through high-quality service and elegant accommodations. Elite Hotels aims to create a unique atmosphere that blends historical charm with modern amenities, catering to both leisure and business travelers. Its clientele includes tourists, corporate guests, and event organizers, while partnerships with local attractions and businesses enhance the overall guest experience. The chain is committed to sustainability, as evidenced by its Green Key ecolabel certification, reflecting its dedication to environmental responsibility.

Name: Ellery Beach House Stockholm
Company description: Discover Ellery Beach House – an idyllic escape nestled in the Stockholm archipelago on the tranquil Lidingö island. At Ellery, urban life feels like a world away as you immerse yourself in a landscape where rustic charm meets coastal luxury. A unique beach house with its own private jetty, Ellery is where serenity and adventure blend into an unforgettable experience. Our guests come seeking not just a stay, but a journey into the heart of the sea, sand, and soulful relaxation. Inspired by the glamorous era of the 60s and 70s, and echoing the allure of Palm Springs, Ellery is a retro-inspired sanctuary. Every corner tells a story – with wooden floors, luxurious velvet sofas, and a curated collection of arts and books, all set against a soothing palette of pink, bronze, blue, and beige. At the heart of Ellery lies the Coco Beach Club, a vibrant playground with indoor and outdoor pools, saunas, cozy fireplaces, and panoramic ocean views. It's a place to relax, dance, and mingle, where delicious cocktails and cozy cabanas create an atmosphere of pure bliss. And for those seeking an extra touch of pampering, our range of indulgent treatments – from scrubs and facials to massages – offers the ultimate in relaxation and rejuvenation. Ellery Beach House is more than just a hotel; it's a celebration of style, comfort, and the good life, set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Stockholm archipelago.

Name: Gerdahallen
Company description: Gerdahallen is a prominent sports and fitness facility located in Lund, Sweden, dedicated to promoting health and wellness within the community. The company offers a wide range of services, including fitness classes, personal training, and access to state-of-the-art gym equipment, catering to individuals of all fitness levels. Gerdahallen's mission is to inspire and empower people to lead active lifestyles, fostering a supportive environment that encourages personal growth and well-being. The facility serves a diverse clientele, including local residents, students, and professionals, and collaborates with various partners to enhance its offerings and community engagement. With a vision to be a leading hub for fitness and health in the region, Gerdahallen is committed to providing exceptional service and innovative programs that meet the evolving needs of its members.

Name: Cirkus Venues
Company description: På Cirkus Venues lever vi för att skapa enastående och minnesvärda upplevelser och vi kan med stolthet säga att vi är riktigt bra på det. Vi är en koncern som består av Hasselbacken, Cirkus Arena & Restaurang, Backstage Hotel, Backstage Brasserie & Bar samt Gasometer som öppnar i Norra Djurgårdsstaden 2027 – alla med egen identitet och personlighet. Det gör att vi kan skapa helt unika helhetslösningar för det perfekta mötet.

Name: Visita - Svensk Besöksnäring
Company description: Visita represents approximately 7,000 hotels, restaurants and other enterprises in the Swedish hospitality sector. As a sector and employer's organisation, we can help you with issues that are time-consuming or difficult to get involved in, thus making it easier for you to manage your business. We provide information and free legal advice, sign collective agreements on behalf of the sector and represent our members in their contacts with unions, public authorities and politicians. Visita is a part of The Confederation of Swedish Enterprise which is Sweden’s largest business federation representing 60 000 member companies with over 1.6 million employees.

Name: Hotel Tylösand
Company description: HOTEL TYLÖSAND - DIT SINNEN ÅKER FÖR ATT TRIGGAS Hotel Tylösand ägs sedan 1995 av Per Gessle och Björn Nordstrand. Sedan dess har hotellet förvandlats till västkustens mest personligt utformade resort med inriktning på inspiration, välbefinnande och modern popkultur. Här kombineras designledande hotellboende med innovativa och högklassiga restauranger, prisbelönt konferens- och spaanläggning, Sveriges största konstgalleri med inriktning på fotokonst och ett pulserande nöjesliv. Allt med den vidsträckta Tylösandsstranden precis utanför.  HOTEL TYLOSAND - WHERE SENSES GO TO BE TICKLED Per Gessle and Björn Nordstrand own Hotel Tylösand since 1995. Since then the hotel gradually has been transformed into one of Sweden’s most forward thinking and innovatively designed resorts for inspiration, wellbeing and soaking up modern pop culture. It’s a place where design driven hotel accommodation is merged with fun dining restaurants, prize-winning conference- and spa facilities, Sweden’s biggest photo art gallery, and a vibrant nightlife. All with the widespread Tylösand beach just outside the window.

Name: Stiftelsen Rosendals Trädgård
Company description: Rosendals Garden is a green oasis situated in central Stockholm. For more than thirtyfive years Rosendals’ Garden Foundation has cultivated and spread knowledge about biodynamic farming practices and horticulture. Rosendals Garden is a driver of the farm to fork concept and the harvest of vegetables, herbs, flowers and fruits are used in the gardens renowned café, woodfired bakery and sold in the farm shop on site. The plantshop provides not only a carefully chosen assortment of garden plants but also floral and garden design services.

Name: Hotel Diplomat Stockholm
Company description: Hotel Diplomat Stockholm is a stylish and elegant hotel located on the prestigious Strandvägen, offering guests a prime location to explore the scenic beauty of Djurgården, high-end shopping at Norrmalmstorg, and the vibrant dining scene at Stureplan. As part of the family-owned Diplomat Collection, which also includes Villa Dagmar and Villa Dahlia, Hotel Diplomat combines modern luxury with timeless elegance in a unique Art Nouveau palace that boasts breathtaking views of the Stockholm waterfront. The hotel caters primarily to adults, providing a sophisticated atmosphere complemented by a range of amenities, including special offers and packages designed for both leisure and business travelers. With a commitment to exceptional service and guest experience, Hotel Diplomat aims to create memorable stays for its clientele, which includes both local and international visitors seeking a luxurious escape in the heart of Stockholm.

Name: The Steam Hotel
Company description: The Steam Hotel Det gamla ångkraftverket vid Mälaren, en gång en av landets största energiproducenter, har stått tomt i snart 25 år. Tills nu när ESS Group, skaparna av Ystad Saltsjöbad och Falkenberg Strandbad - två av Sveriges mest prisbelönta spa- och resorthotell, har förvandlat ångkraftverket från 1917 till ett 18 våningar hotell med 227 rum, restauranger, barer, konferenslokaler och spa. Med 15 meter till vattenkanten, dryga kilometern till centralstationen och knappa milen till Västerås flygplats erbjuder vi en helhetsupplevelse som sträcker sig långt utöver den vanlig konferensen. Mötesplatsen Möteslokalerna, varav den största har en kapacitet för upp till ca 550 personer, andas precis som övriga hotellet historien från det gamla ångkraftverket. Miljön från det industriellt råa kraftverket har mjukats upp genom varma materialval, mattor och möbler för att skapa en inbjudande och välkomnande känsla. Vår ambition är att skapa funktionella lokaler, utrustade med den senaste tekniken, där ni verkligen kommer trivas och vill stanna kvar även efter mötets slut. Läs mer här: https://www.steamhotel.se/konferens-malardalen/ Restaurangerna Den stora restaurangen på bottenvåningen, The Chamberlin, välkomnar er med en stor öppen brasa och ett livligt kök som växer ut i restaurangen. Med stora blyinfattade fönster som vetter ut mot Mälaren och den livfulla hamnen, sitter ni i en varm och skön miljö och njuter av internationellt inspirerad mat med fokus på grill och lokalproducerade råvaror. Här är vår ambition att trots kapaciteten på 300 platser, skapa en ombonad känsla, långt från de opersonliga kongressrestauranger vi är vana att se. Högst upp, på 18e våningen blir det en mäktig roof top restaurang, Locavore, där du njuter av mat och dryck omringad av den vidsträckta utsikten. Bara det en upplevelse i sig. Varmt välkommen till en helt ny värld och premiären för en ny historia.

Name: Hotell- Och Restaurangfacket HRF
Company description: Hotell- Och Restaurangfacket (HRF) is a Swedish trade union representing workers in the hotel and restaurant sectors. The organization is dedicated to advocating for the rights and interests of its members, providing them with a platform to influence leadership and decision-making through congresses held every three years. HRF is structured into eight local divisions, each with its own board and staff, ensuring that members receive tailored support based on their specific regional needs. The union's leadership, including the president, vice president, and contract secretary, is elected during these congresses, which also set the strategic goals and priorities for the organization. HRF's mission is to empower its members and enhance their working conditions, while its vision focuses on fostering a fair and equitable workplace environment in the hospitality industry. Through collaboration with various stakeholders, HRF aims to strengthen the collective voice of its members and drive positive change within the sector.

Name: ICEHOTEL
Company description: Icehotel – the original – a world famous hotel and an art exhibition made of ice and snow. Open year round! Founded in 1989, it is reborn in a new guise every winter, in the Swedish village of Jukkasjärvi – 200 km north of the Arctic Circle. The Torne River, the arts, and creating a setting for life-enriching moments are at the heart of it all. Our mission is to create life enriching experiences, in Jukkasjärvi and beyond. We create art work of ice, snow and magnetite. Not to mention build a hotel of ice and snow each year from scratch. The walls, floors and ceilings of the hotel are the canvases of designers from all creative disciplines. The artists and art work vary from year to year, each rendition of the hotel presenting an ephemeral collection. We proudly create events all over the world, build ICEBAR's, offer a vast variety of adventure travel all over Swedish Lapland and northern Norway.

Name: Clarion Hotel Malmö Live
Company description: The coolest hotel in the Öresund region! Standing 85 metres above sea level, the 2nd tallest building in Malmö. With one restaurant and three bars, together with 444 hotel rooms and a congress facility, the opportunities are endless! The hotel holds 23 conference venues and the largest congress hall in the area with a capacity of 1500 delegates. All the conferences and events are costumized and nothing is impossible - only sky is the limit!

Name: Stockholm Meeting Selection
Company description: Upptäck våra minnesvärda destinationer. Välj mellan slott, herrgård eller spahotell. Vi har 12 mötesplatser med 144 konferenslokaler och 736 hotellrum. Dessutom flera restauranger, barer, spa, gym, padelbanor och relaxavdelningar. I Stockholm Meeting Selection ingår Hesselby Slott där musiken tar plats, festernas Näsby Slott, det kungliga Rosersbergs Slottshotell, Lejondals Slott ett riktigt sagoslott, Ulfsunda Slott som är långt ifrån vardag, Skytteholm Hotell & Konferens vid Mälarens Strand, idrottens Bosön, Villa Lovik med havet precis intill, Villa Foresta som tronar på Lidingö, det gröna Åkeshofs Slott och Sturegatan 15 i city som ligger vägg i vägg med restaurang Hantverket där både mat och inredning är ett hantverk.

Name: Sheraton Stockholm
Company description: The Sheraton Stockholm Hotel is located in the very heart of Stockholm’s central business district, shopping areas, and attractions – Perfect for both business and leisure guests.  The hotel offers stunning views of Lake Mälaren, City Hall, and Old Town. Whether you are on business or pleasure you will enjoy your stay with us. We have a wide range of rooms and suites, a restaurant and bar in which to dine or relax with friends. Our concierge is available to make sure that you get the most out of your stay in Stockholm. We are located; a two-minute walk from the Old Town and moments away from shopping and night life. The Arlanda Express only takes 20 minutes from the airport, and arrives at the Central Station, a one-minute walk from the hotel. Underground secure-parking is located in direct conjunction with the hotel with a lift that takes you directly to lobby level.

Name: Avalon Hotel & Restaurang
Company description: Konst- och designhotell i centrala Göteborg.

Name: At Six
Company description: Elegance reborn.  Brunkebergstorg, Stockholm. A 19th century haven for socialites. And that’s where it all begins. A rebirth. A reimagining. A hotel to be seen. En vogue elegance in a new home. Where contemporary art meets design. Where dining revels in breathtaking views. Where sleep is nurtured by comfort. Where spacious comes as standard. Where detail intrigues with a twist. Where surprise is no surprise. The place, At Six. Sleep. Dine. Mingle. Surprise. Welcome inside.

Name: Grand Hôtel Stockholm
Company description: The Grand Hôtel in Stockholm has been home to celebrities, high-profile events and everyday bon-vivants since 1874. Situated in the best waterfront location imaginable, the hotel overlooks the Royal Palace and Gamla Stan, Stockholm’s old town. The Grand is also home to the classic Swedish Veranda restaurant, renowned for its traditional smörgåsbord, Mathias Dahlgren’s Matbaren and the spectacular Cadier Bar. For recreation, there’s the Nordic Spa & Fitness club with hot saunas and cool dipping pools.

Name: Nordic Light Hotel
Company description: Nordic Light Hotel is where the essence of the Nordics comes alive.  We are a contemporary meeting place, right in the hustle and bustle of central Stockholm. Here, the vibrant city is reflected in a house that never sleeps.

Name: Camp Ripan
Company description: Camp Ripan is a family-owned experience facility located in Kiruna, where the breathtaking Arctic landscape meets a city undergoing constant transformation. The company is dedicated to sustainable tourism, guided by its comprehensive sustainability strategy known as the Camp Ripan Model, which focuses on social responsibility, local engagement, and climate consciousness. By promoting local culture and supporting regional producers, Camp Ripan aims to strengthen the local economy while providing guests with authentic experiences that reflect the area's unique heritage. The company prioritizes employee well-being and development, ensuring a fair and inclusive work environment. With a commitment to reducing its climate impact, Camp Ripan employs eco-friendly practices and educates both staff and guests on sustainability. Its target market includes environmentally conscious travelers seeking immersive cultural experiences in a stunning natural setting.

Name: Marstrands Havshotell AB
Company description: That barren, salty, windswept calm, that constant encounter between land and sea is made for inspiration and gathering by the sea, all year round.  Here at Marstrands Havshotell we know exactly how to create the perfect meeting and event. We match personal service, knowledge and commitment with experience and a very unique location. From beginning to end.  No matter if you are looking for a private villa on a remote island, a greenhouse or a more traditional conference room, for big or small groups, Marstrands Havshotell is the place to come to.  Our conference packages always coffee breaks with in-house made cakes and snacks, relaxation in our west coast inspired SPA, mouth-watering meals in our restaurant Ottos Kök and in one of our 98 rooms you’ll find tranquillity at the end of the day.  With an activity you will make the conference extra memorable. We offer a wide selection of activities both on sea and shore.  Book your next conference or event with us. Because we are not like everyone else, but neither are you and your colleagues.  Welcome to the sea. Less than an hour from Gothenburg.

Name: Villa Dagmar Stockholm
Company description: A vibrant villa and an international hotel experience located in the heart of Stockholm. Villa Dagmar is an intimate boutique hotel with 70 individually designed guest rooms and suites as well as a range of restaurant experiences, event and private dining areas, a concept store, a flower shop, a spa and a fitness centre. This stunning home away from home, is the perfect space for the modern traveller who seeks a space with authentic character in one of Stockholm’s most prestigious neighbourhoods next to Östermalms saluhall. Villa Dagmar belongs to the same family as the renowned Hotel Diplomat. Villa Dagmar is the second hotel within the family-owned Diplomat Collection which also includes Hotel Diplomat and Villa Dahlia.

Name: Hotel Skansen I Båstad
Company description: A hub of activity in the summer, a relaxing retreat in the winter. With the panoramic windows offering gorgeous sea views, Bjäre flavors coming out of the kitchen, and delightful guests all year round, come enjoy the special atmosphere that is sure to make you smile. As the 1900s king of Båstad Ludvig Nobel would say: “In Båstad, we live a life of leisure.”

Name: Bank Hotel
Company description: Bank Hotel, located in the heart of Stockholm at Arsenalsgatan 6, is a luxurious destination that combines historic charm with modern elegance. As a proud member of the Small Luxury Hotels of the World, the hotel aims to provide an exceptional experience for its guests, focusing on personalized service and high-quality amenities. The hotel's mission is to create memorable moments for visitors, whether they are enjoying a leisurely brunch at Bonnie’s or relaxing in the beautifully designed spaces. Catering primarily to discerning travelers and locals seeking a unique dining experience, Bank Hotel emphasizes sustainability and quality in all its offerings. With a commitment to excellence, the hotel serves as a premier choice for both business and leisure clients looking for a sophisticated stay in Stockholm.

Name: Artipelag
Company description: Artipelag is a unique venue outside Stockholm where art exhibitions, cultural activities, architecture, design and excellent food is combined with beautiful nature and stunning views.

Name: Ad Astra By Elite - Hotel Spa & Resort
Company description: Ad Astra by Elite is a distinguished hotel brand within the Elite Hotels group, offering a unique blend of historic charm and modern luxury. Located in prime city centers, such as Gothenburg, Ad Astra by Elite aims to provide guests with an exceptional experience characterized by high-quality service, elegant accommodations, and a commitment to sustainability, as evidenced by its Green Key ecolabel certification. The hotel caters to a diverse clientele, including business travelers, tourists, and event organizers, providing tailored services for conferences, weddings, and special occasions. With a focus on comfort and guest satisfaction, Ad Astra by Elite partners with local businesses to enhance the overall experience, ensuring that every stay is memorable and enjoyable. The brand's mission is to create a welcoming atmosphere where guests can relax and feel at home while exploring the vibrant surroundings of their chosen location.

Name: Ett Hem
Company description: Ett Hem, three beautiful private houses and garden in the  centre of Stockholm that has been created for people looking  for something more personal than the luxury hotel. Ett Hem was a private residence built in 1910, for two people who loved art and beautiful things. They left their mark on this townhouse, situated in a peaceful, residential area of Stockholm. This Arts and Crafts building is a tranquil home away from home, steeped in the Scandinavian aesthetics of Carl Larsson and his wife Karin. Transforming the house into a hotel has been a delicate process: its personality had to remain intact. Yet it also had to offer all the services required by modern travellers. The result is that Ett Hem is again filled with the best collection of furniture, Scandinavian antiques and design. Things that frame moments in life. With 25 rooms, Ett Hem offers discerning guests comfortable interiors and bedrooms full of summery whiteness of light. Outdoors, the courtyard garden is a room as important as those inside. It’s a secret city wilderness that is the perfect place for summer breakfasts or winding down over a chilled bottle of wine.

Name: Falkenberg Strandbad
Company description: Falkenberg Strandbad, a waterfront hotel located on the sand beaches of Skrea strand. The hotel with its renowned spa and conference facilities makes it one the most prestigious destinations on the west coast. Upon your arrival at Falkenberg Strandbad you enter a hotel featuring a lifestyle based on the adventurous life of Ernest Hemingway. The hotel lobby is more than just a lobby, it is the living room of Mr. Hemingway himself filled with vintage books, handcrafted exotic animal sculptures and large colonial seating arrangements. Many guests find themselves starting and ending their evenings with a fine glass of oak-aged rum while nibbling on dark chocolate in front of the open fireplace.   The conference rooms are decorated with designed carpets and paintings of the mid-1920’s and are installed with the latest technology. The facilities allow guests to engage in meetings while overlooking the calm sea of Kattegatt to find additional inspiration and creativity. During breaks guests tend to enjoy refreshments in the living room of Mr. Hemingway or on the long 250-meter long wooden beach bridge located in connection to the hotel.   The spa, named The Retreat Club draw its inspiration from the ancient Kalahari dessert in Africa. The Club features some of the most well kept secrets from the local Kalahari inhabitants. These secrets are experienced areas covered with marble, mosaic stone and golden details. Pamper yourself with a glass of champagne and a panoramic view of the beach in an over-sized relaxing bed. Furthermore, continue the day with a gastronomic journey in our French inspired restaurant, Famille, with Mr. Hemingway’s favorite choice of wine, glass of exquisite Bourgogne wine.

Name: Helio Workspaces
Company description: Helio Workspaces is a dynamic coworking space provider based in Stockholm, dedicated to creating innovative and collaborative environments for professionals and businesses. The company aims to enhance work experiences through modern amenities and a strong community focus, fostering connections among its members. Helio hosts a variety of events, including seminars on cutting-edge topics such as 5G technology and digitalization, featuring insights from industry experts and partners like Tre and Proptivity. Its target market includes freelancers, startups, and established companies seeking flexible office solutions that promote productivity and creativity. With a commitment to integrating technology and community engagement, Helio Workspaces is shaping the future of workspaces in Sweden.

Name: LivNordic
Company description: Raison d’Etre’s own spa brand, LivNordic is a blend of the long proven Nordic health traditions combined with the latest in spa and wellness.  LivNordic reflects on the Nordic traditions and cultures which are based on four simple principles: - A deep abiding love for nature; - Cultivating authentic relationships with others, our environment and ourselves; - Connecting to the inner stillness at the heart of Nordic wellness; - Enjoying the natural simplicity found in all things Scandinavian We adopted these principles as the founding values for creating LivNordic, a unique luxury lifestyle Hotel and Wellbeing brand offering our guests spaces to connect, recharge and enjoy life – The Nordic Way. Connectivity to nature, a healthy lifestyle, beauty, and sound mindfulness are characteristics of the Nordic people. The LivNordic Spa pursues holistic wellbeing by drawing on the rich resource that Nordic culture, traditional and contemporary, has to offer. Simply – Coming a little closer to Living Nordic.

Name: PM & Vänner
Company description: PM & Vänner bildades 1992 av två vänner, Per Bengtsson & Monica Carlsson (anledningen till namnet PM) som då hoppade av sin ekonomiutbildning för att starta restaurang. De är än idag delägare. Koncernen inkluderar idag PM & Vänner Hotel, PM Restaurant, PM Bistro, PM Bröd & Sovel, PM Fest & konferens samt vår bar på taket, enkelt namngiven PM Bar. Vår verksamhet utgår från hjärtat av Småland, i centrala Växjö. Vår gastronomiska filosofi är baserad på de tre grundstenarna skog, äng & sjö. Genom den vill vi visa upp den stora variation vår region erbjuder i form av råvaror och tradition inom matlagning. Vi strävar efter att tolka vår historia på ett modernt sätt genom att kombinera såväl gamla som nya tekniker i köket. Vårt hotell följer samma princip som vår gastronomi och kärleken och passionen till mat och dryck samt design ska vara tydligt genom hela vistelsen på PM & Vänner Hotel. Vi har under många år jobbat målmedvetet för ett hållbart företagande och försöker att påverka miljön så lite som möjligt. Vi är idag certifierade av Svanen, KRAV och blev 2010 tilldelade ”årets hållbara gastronomi” av White Guide. Vi hoppas att du som gäst kommer trivas på våra olika verksamheter. Varmt välkommen!

Name: Best Western Malmö Arena Hotel
Company description: Malmö Arena Hotel är ett familjeägt och färgrikt event- och affärshotell på bästa läge i Malmö Hyllie. Vi är en del av Best Western, den världsomspännande hotellkedjan. Här kan du övernatta i ett av våra 395 rum, där du kan välja mellan flera olika rumskategorier från standard till svit. Vi har rum för alla. De ljusa och fräscha rummen har en enkel och elegant utformning med högkvalitativa materialval och mycket komfortabla sängar. Givetvis finns det möjlighet att mörklägga och reglera värmen i rummen.  Efter en god natts sömn i våra tysta rum väntar en dignande frukostbuffé på dig. Behöver du gå upp extra tidigt har vi specialservice så att du inte missar frukosten.    Vi har fantastiska möjligheter att skräddarsy din konferens. Hotellet har flexibla och ljusa möteslokaler, en unik service och underbar mat. Dessutom med en konferensfika i världsklass, att njuta av i pausen. Tack vare den direkta anknytningen till Malmö Arena kan vi arrangera möten för allt mellan 5-14 000 personer. Dessutom är det extra bekvämt med en direktpassage inomhus mellan anläggningarna.  Hotellet har Malmös största skybar på 16:e våningen, med 360 graders utsikt över Öresund och Malmö. Här kan du också boka in ditt mingel eller möte. På hotellet hittar du även Nilssons Restaurang & Bar där du kan unna dig en härlig lunch och middag. Här står de nordiska och lokala råvarorna i fokus och kockarna bjuder på spännande smakkombinationer med influenser från hela världen. Njut av riktigt bra mat på enkelt manér. Malmö Arena Hotel är beläget mellan Malmö Arena och Malmömässan, den största mässanläggningen i Malmö. Hotellet ligger 150 meter från Malmö Hyllie Station och shoppingcentret Emporia.  Med tåg tar det 12 minuterna till Copenhagen Airport och 25 minuter till Köpenhamns centrum. Till centrala Malmö tar det 3 minuter.  Varmt välkommen - vi ser fram emot att skämma bort dig!

Name: Skogshem & Wijk
Company description: Skogshem & Wijk - En plats skapad för möten! Har du behov av en konferensanläggning väl anpassad för en effektiv konferens i Stockholm? Då är vi platsen för dig! Du hittar oss på det vackra Elfvikslandet ute på Lidingö. Med hjälp av Norra Länken når du oss snabbare och lättare än vad någon av oss kan tro! Vi är en fullsortiments anläggning där du kan anordna såväl en rolig kick off som ett färgstarkt event eller varför inte genomföra en utbildning.  Hos oss på Skogshem & Wijk anordnar du med lätthet din dagkonferens, bolagsstämma, ledningsgruppsträff eller styrelsemöte. Vi har även lokaler för mässor, kongresser och teamträningar. Planerar du en firmafest eller 50-års fest  - lika välkommen då! Vet du att när du bokar ett möte hos oss på Skogshem & Wijk ingår det alltid massor av mervärden… Allt du behöver satsa är lite av din tid (glöm inte ta med den tiden hit bara). För oss på Skogshem & Wijk är det viktigt med rörelse och en liten paus, därför finns det alltid tillgång till gåstavar, cyklar, pingis- & biljardbord, egna löparspår, den vackra energigivande naturen och mycket mera. Du har alltid tillgång till vår varma utomhuskälla/pool som håller ca 35 grader året om. Bastu & relax finns öppen för dig liksom våra 2 fullt utrustade gym med maskiner och fria vikter.  Till lunch serverar vi alltid en 4-rätters buffé, fisk, kött, vegetarisk, soppa samt en härlig salladsbuffé. Kaffebuffén är alltid uppdukad med frukt och annat gott och till middag får du avnjuta en 3-rätters middag. Vi är en plats skapad för möten med trivsel, tradition & kvalitet som ger dig och din grupp Business Energy. Hjärtligt välkommen till oss Snabbfakta 222 hotellrum 290 bäddar 50 konferenslokaler 2-550 personer i konferens 2 fullt utrustade gym 3 löparslingor  2 varma utomhuskällor 1 padelbana

Name: Fållan
Company description: Fållan is a dynamic event venue located in Johanneshov, Sweden, dedicated to hosting a variety of live performances and cultural events. With a mission to create memorable experiences, Fållan aims to bring together artists and audiences in an intimate setting that fosters creativity and connection. The venue is particularly known for its collaboration with influential artists like Mwuana, who has made a significant impact on the Swedish hip-hop scene. Fållan caters to a diverse audience, including music enthusiasts and fans of various genres, and partners with reputable event organizers such as Luger to deliver high-quality shows. With a commitment to showcasing both emerging and established talent, Fållan is poised to be a cornerstone of the Swedish music landscape.

Name: Västervik Resort
Company description: Västervik Resort is one of Sweden's largest resort facilities in the heart of the archipelago city of Västervik, 3 km from the center. We work to create an overall experience where you can safely and securely live and vacation in a good mix so that you get as pleasant and fantastic an experience as possible. We have accommodation in the form of cabins, caravans, rooms and a 5-star campsite. With us you create memories for a lifetime!

Name: Ramundberget
Company description: Ramundberget, en utpost vid vägens ände och på gränsen till den orörda fjällvärlden. Alltsedan 1936 då de första gästerna knackade på dörren har fler och fler fattat tycke för Ramis. Idag är vi en etablerad liten skidort med ett mycket starkt varumärke och där bolaget äger och driver det mesta som man möts av som gäst. Själva litenheten är ett nyckelord som vi värnar om och behandlar med respekt även när vi planerar för det framtida Ramundberget. Hela vår verksamhet vilar på tre fundament: Naturen, Värdskapet och Historien. Naturen i form av att vid vägs ände förvalta och hantera den gåva i form av fjäll, vattendrag och mängden snö som gör skidåkningen möjlig från tidig höst till sen vår. Värdskapet som bottnar i Agaton & Britas sätt att ta hand om de allra första gästerna och där det alltid fanns plats för en till vid köksbordet. Få skidorter i Sverige har också en historia värd att berätta, i Ramundberget blev sagan sann och vi själva är en del av den, bära kulturarvet och dessutom utveckla det på ett varsamt är ett stort ansvar vi har tagit på oss. Ramundberget är ett äkta småskaligt alternativ till de som söker något bortom det massproducerade och lättkonsumerade. Självklart har vi höga ambitioner med våra parker, restaurangar, barnområden och konferens, men eftersom vi är en skidort som tänker lite annorlunda, sker all expansion utifrån våra fundament. Vi kommer nog aldrig att bli en ort för alla, men för allt fler verkar vi vara den enda skidort man kan tänka sig.  Stora som små Med nya moderna mötesrum tar vi nu emot grupper för stormöten, utbildningar, styrelsemöten, kick-off, fest och events. Maten serveras vägg-i-vägg i vår nya restaurang Grytan kök & bar eller bara ett stenkast över bytorget på anrika restaurangen Mor Britas där allt en gång började. Önskas mat på Ösjöstugan eller restaurang Tusen med vida vyer går det lika bra. Kort och gott, vi ser till att energinivåerna är rätt under konferensen med pauser, lunch och middag.

Name: The Vault Hotel
Company description: Detta är mer än ett hotell, det är en upplevelse.  Redan i entrén överraskas du av den fantastiska byggnaden. Om du tar upp kameran och fotograferar direkt är du en av många som gör samma sak.  Atmosfären och inredningen är helt unik och värdskapet personligt och varmt. Name: Lydinge Resort
Company description: Lydinge Resort   Längtar du efter en oas där du bara kan koppla av och njuta av lugnet och den vackra skånska naturen? Då är Lydinge Resort helt rätt för dig! När hotellet byggdes var det känslan som stod i fokus. I byggnationen användes träbjälkar från Lydinge gård och tegel från Hyllinges gamla tegelbruk. Vägg målningar och tavlor i hotellet målades av kusin Sara Gibrand. Målet var att skapa en familjär, geniun och skön känsla i klubbhus och hotell.  Hotellet innehåller 43 charmiga rum, en frisörsalong, fysioterapeut och relaxavdelning med bastu och bubbelpool. Hotellet ligger intill huvudbyggnaden och har tillsammans 5 välutrustade konferensrum och en härligt genuin restaurang, utanför ligger Lydinges 18-håls golfbana, fiskedamm, upplyst motionsslinga och en magisk skånsk natur.  Ideen om Lydinge Resort kom för redan 20 år sedan med driving range och korthålsbana, 2004 stod 18-håls golfbanan klar, 2012 byggdes huvudbyggnaden med restaurang och konferens, 2018 invigdes det nybyggda hotellet av Europatour golfproffset Joakim Lagergren, en god vän till familjen.  Lydinge Resort ligger 15 kilometer från Helsingborg och drygt 20 kilometer från Helsingborgs flygplats. 450 meter från hotellet hittar du en busshållplats (Hyllinge Torget) och du som kommer med bil parkerar här utan kostnad.   För dig som vill shoppa ligger dessutom ett av Sveriges bästa shoppingcentrum, Väla Centrum, bara några minuter bort med bil eller buss. Media runt om i Skandinavien uppmärksammade Lydinge Resorts frammarch i branschen och hotellet blev oerhört välbesökt redan första året.
